episodes.title: Four Hours and Forty-Eight
episodes.synopsis: Rolling blackouts begin. The two numbers that matter: a closed fridge holds four hours, a full freezer holds forty-eight.

episodes.title: One Minute
episodes.synopsis: The payoff to day three. Water treatment doses chemicals on GPS time. How to boil water correctly, and what boiling cannot fix.

episodes.title: The Order Things Run Out
episodes.synopsis: Shops do not empty randomly. They empty in an order. What to buy, and why boring food beats frightening food.

episodes.title: Nobody Is Watching the Weather
episodes.synopsis: Weather satellites are gone and nobody can see a system coming. How to forecast with a barometer and the sky.

episodes.title: The Clock You Didn't Know You Had
episodes.synopsis: The keystone. Every GPS satellite carries an atomic clock, and that was always the real cargo. The power grid, cell networks, banking and water treatment all run on it.

episodes.title: North
episodes.synopsis: GPS position degrades. The blue dot still appears, because the software will not admit it does not know. How to find north with a stick and two stones.

episodes.title: The Sky Is Full of Glass
episodes.synopsis: Two satellites collide over the Barents Sea and the cascade begins. Satellite television and internet go first. How to find news when the sky stops talking.
